description: Ministry of Justice - Council of Legal Education Ordinance - Amended Ex. Gaz. No. 2332/02 on 23/05/2023 Sinhala and Tamil
reasoning: This gazette content contains rules made by the Incorporated Council of Legal Education with ministerial concurrence, amending legal education requirements and examination procedures. It establishes regulatory frameworks for legal education qualifications and admission standards to the Sri Lanka Law College, falling squarely under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes.
